forbidden.name: no-circular
forbidden.comment: #782 step 8: no module may import itself through others, in every folder, netlify/functions/ and bin/ included. The proposal sets no folder rules yet, so this is the only rule. Exception (#791, Rule exceptions log): the 34 cycles in .dependency-cruiser-known-violations.json, all in netlify/functions/, are held by lint:cycles' --ignore-known until #925 untangles them; test/quality-cycles-known.test.mjs lets that file only shrink.
